headline: Democrats face limited options on cost of living
standfirst: The economy remains a top voter concern despite recent election outcomes.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Voters are frustrated by high prices. Analysts say Democrats have few tools to fix this soon.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Rising living costs drove a massive political shift. Voters prioritized their wallets.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Economic stress caused a historic political swing. It shows how deeply inflation impacts elections.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for future policy shifts or economic data over the next two years to see if relief arrives.

caption:
Voters are worried about the economy and high prices despite the recent election results.

Rising costs were a major factor in the recent political upheaval. Experts suggest that even with a change in leadership, solving these economic stressors will be difficult in the near term.
